observed: Extremely small positive Fisher probabilities are returned as floating-point 0.0, with no explicit underflow diagnostic; their Holm-adjusted values are also 0.0.
impact: No decision changes in this case, but bare zero can be misread as mathematical probability zero.
future_work: Distinguish numerical underflow from an exact zero probability in machine-readable output and human-facing tables.
Use an explicit underflow flag or a numerical bound supported by the calculation; do not infer an arbitrary bound solely from a returned zero.
Cover the two saved examples and ordinary small nonzero p-values with an independent reference check.
scope: Documentation only. No numerical result, analysis specification, randomisation setting or toolkit implementation changed.
